claims.text: Three baselines were tested for answerability identification, including SVM and CNN models, which improved performance over a majority-class baseline.
The results show that the best-performing baseline, Bert + Unanswerable, achieved an F1 score of 39.8, indicating the effectiveness of the tested baselines.
The study establishes baselines for the subtask of deciding on the answerability of a question, indicating that various methods were compared.
